law_name: Law of 11 March 1957 on Literary and Artistic Property (French law applied in Comoros); Bangui Agreement (OAPI) since 2013
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 21 of 1957 law); anonymous, collective and posthumous works 50 years from publication
notes: Berne since 17 Apr 2005; Bangui Agreement since 25 May 2013 (Commons). Unclear whether OAPI Annex VII (possibly life + 70) now overrides the 1957 term; not confirmed.
